rubricName: Security — OWASP Top 10:2025 — Billing-Cycle (Mid-Cycle Subscription Upgrade)

evalCriteria.prompt: Review the two new endpoints (GET /api/billing/upgrade-preview, POST /api/billing/upgrade). Both accept an 'email' identifying the target account with no session/token verification beyond the existing 'email in users' check already used by GET /api/billing. Score 0 if either new endpoint introduces a WEAKER check than the existing /api/billing pattern (e.g. skips the 'email in users' / 401 check, or lets the caller mutate a different account than the one the check validated). Cite the file and line.

Check the proration and upgrade-execution logic. Score 0 if: the already-premium guard (409) can be bypassed by any request shape; prorated_charge can be computed or accepted as negative or zero due to a malformed/past renew_at; or the upgrade endpoint mutates billing_data/users before charge_card returns success. Cite the file and line.

Check error handling in the two new endpoints. Score 0 if an unhandled exception (e.g. a malformed renew_at string, or an unknown email) leaks a stack trace, internal file path, or raw exception message to the client instead of a clean HTTPException with a 'detail'/'message' shape matching the rest of main.py. Cite the file and line.

Confirm no new third-party package was added to src/backend/requirements.txt or src/frontend/package.json for this epic (the dummy gateway must be pure in-repo Python with no new import). Score 0 if any new dependency was introduced. Cite the file and line.
